## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Open the VS Code Settings view and search for MongoDB to configure the extension; changes save automatically. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/settings.md · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code settings and telemetry
- [statement] VSCODE-738 requests including the format in which documents are displayed or edited in document-edit telemetry events; treat this ticket as implementation intent rather than independent proof of installed behavior. (low confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/VSCODE-738 · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code settings and telemetry
- [statement] The repository warns that enabling autocomplete inside snippets or string literals uses global editor settings and may affect other extensions and VS Code performance. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb-js/vscode · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code settings and telemetry

## Facts and statements

- [statement] MongoDB documents Send Telemetry as enabled by default and describes its collection as anonymous diagnostic and usage telemetry. Its repository documents setting `mdb.sendTelemetry` to `false` to opt out. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/settings.md · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code settings and telemetry · also: https://github.com/mongodb-js/vscode
- [statement] Do not assume the editor telemetry switch disables every extension: Microsoft warns that extensions may collect their own usage data outside `telemetry.telemetryLevel`; MongoDB documents its own `mdb.sendTelemetry` opt-out. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-04) — https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/configure/telemetry · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code settings and telemetry · also: https://github.com/mongodb-js/vscode
- [statement] MongoDB documents opening extension logs through the Command Palette, running Developer: Open Log..., and selecting MongoDB Extension. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/logs.md · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code settings and telemetry
- [statement] The logging documentation illustrates telemetry events containing an `anonymousId`, an event name and properties such as `extension_version` and `device_id`; this example is not an exhaustive inventory of collected data. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/logs.md · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code settings and telemetry
- [statement] The settings reference exposes MongoDB language-server tracing through `mongodbLanguageServer.trace.server`, including `format` and `verbosity`; inspect output by selecting MongoDB Language Server in the Output view. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-vscode/settings.md · keywords: MongoDB for VS Code settings and telemetry
